title: Review output
description: One record per (case_id, trial). Produced by review_stage.py. Cache location: {cache_root}/{model}/review_<judge>/<judge>.jsonl. Schema source: review_stage.review_schema().

overrides.description: Absent-means-confirmed list of per-option verdict overrides. Each promotion override cites the extracted action_id that supports it, or null when the response did the action but match didn't extract a matching action (explicit coverage-gap signal).

action_id.description: Cites the extracted action (match actions[].id) that supports the override. Null when the response did the action but match didn't extract it, or when the override is a demotion.

runtime.description: Per-call wall time in seconds. May be null for re-emitted records.
